text:
finance: Quick heads-up for the company: we're rolling out two billing changes next month — (1) free credit expiration policy tightened and (2) more granular invoice line-itemization for usage and discounts. Details below.

olivia-cs: Is this going to affect customers who signed up in the last 30 days? We had a few on trials.

finance: Short answer: were adding a 90-day expiration window for promotional free credits (was effectively indefinite for older grants). Were grandfathering credits issued before the policy announcement for 120 days. We'll email affected customers with clear dates and transition options.

leah-product: rationale? will this change confuse self-serve folks?

finance: twofold: (a) prevent stale credit liabilities on accounting side, (b) encourage evaluation-to-purchase flow. We'll add a Console banner and an "apply for extension" support path for startups.

alex-marketing: we should coordinate the public copy. Keep customer-facing note simple: "Free credits now expire after 90 days; we'll notify you in advance." Avoid legalese.

finance: noted. We'll keep the public blog short and link to the help article with examples.

billing-bot: SCHEDULED ACTION: Notification emails will go out in three waves: 30 days, 14 days, and 3 days before credit expiry. Draft email saved in /docs/billing/free-credit-rollout-draft.md (owner: finance).

tom-sre: any infra or telemetry work here? we need to track who redeems credits and ensure no invoice regressions.

finance: yes  we added new metric `credits_expiring_count` and `credits_redeemed_last_30d`. Billing pipeline will emit invoice-diff artifacts for the first 2 billing cycles after rollout for audit.

dennis-legal: flag: make sure opt-in promo terms comply with regional consumer regulations (EU). Also confirm the notice windows meet our contract terms for enterprise credits.

finance: we'll run the email cadence through legal for EU language variations. Enterprise credits (custom deals) are excluded by default; sales can request exceptions.

leah-product: second piece: invoice line-itemization? what's changing there?

finance: currently invoices lump generation, embeddings, and usage discounts. New invoices will break out: route-level usage, per-model SKU, discounts, promo credit application, and tax breakdowns. This should reduce support tickets where customers ask "what is this charge for".

olivia-cs: huge win. Will we provide a CSV export for ingestion into accounting systems?

finance: yes  CSV and JSON invoice export, plus new invoice API endpoint for programmatic retrieval. We'll publish an example mapping for QuickBooks and Xero.

billing-bot: TIMELINE:
- Day 0 (today): Announcement
- Day 7: Docs & help center update publish
- Day 21: Console invoice preview rollout (beta)
- Day 45: CSV/JSON exports live
- Day 90: Free credits 90-day expiration enforced for new grants

tom-sre: ops ask: during preview can we keep a "legacy invoice" toggle for customers to opt to the old format if they need it temporarily?

finance: yes, toggle available to org-admins during preview. Default for new orgs will be new format after Day 45.

alex-marketing: webinar idea: "Understanding your Redwood invoice" for finance teams. I'll coordinate with Olivia and Finance for a short session.

olivia-cs: please include a simple FAQ for CS: common Qs like "my credits disappeared" and "how to apply promo codes".

finance: will do. Draft FAQ will land in /docs/support/free-credits-faq.md.

dennis-legal: also check tax line detail for VAT vs GST presentation. We need to ensure tax IDs show correctly in exports.

finance: noted. We'll test exports with EU/ANZ tax examples.

billing-bot: ACTION CREATED: ticket BILL-3247 to implement invoice export schema (owner: eng-billing).

leah-product: any expected customer impact on final amount? the split is just cosmetic right?

finance: correct, it's reformatting only. No change to how usage is calculated except the credit expiry rule. All changes will be non-destructive; first invoices post-rollout will include a small "invoice preview diff" section for transparency.

tom-sre: sounds good. Can we get an alert if invoice-diff > 10% compared to previous cycle for any org?

finance: yes  we'll add `invoice_diff_alert` with threshold 10% and route it to #support-escalations.

finance: Thanks all. We'll publish the help doc link once the draft is finalized; ping finance if you want to review wording. End of thread.
